artifact.title: Bounded retry helper for the Plan Studio provider fetch
artifact.objective: Add a bounded retry helper around the Plan Studio provider invoke in runtime/lib/plan-studio.mjs: the provider fetch is attempted once, retried exactly once after a 2-second delay on failure, and both failures surface one clear error that preserves the existing providerLogPath/last-response diagnostics.
constraints: Bounded to the studio provider fetch path: the invoke call inside runPlanProvider in runtime/lib/plan-studio.mjs; regenerateProposal and all other runtime fetch paths are unchanged.
Exactly one retry with a fixed 2-second delay; no backoff ladder, no extra stages, no new configuration surface.
Confirmation and usage gates still run exactly once before the first attempt; the retry never re-runs a gate.
On both attempts failing, throw a single clear error that keeps the existing withLog contract (providerLogPath plus the last provider response) so the browser can still offer the transcript.
No real provider is contacted by changes or verification; tests use a fake invoke and an injectable or short-circuited delay.
Do not claim any check passed; do not execute commands or change files while producing this plan.
risks: One extra invoke doubles provider spend and latency for calls that fail persistently.
A hard-coded 2-second wait makes the both-fail test path slow or flaky unless the delay is injectable in tests.
Retrying a provider call that partially executed before failing could duplicate side effects on the provider side.
Retrying may convert a fast-fail into a slow-fail for the Plan Studio UI, delaying error feedback by ~2 seconds.
completion_checks: A retry helper exists in runtime/lib/plan-studio.mjs that makes at most two invoke attempts separated by a 2-second delay.
runPlanProvider routes its provider fetch through the retry helper with the delay injectable for tests.
A first attempt that throws or returns a non-zero code is followed by exactly one retry, and a successful retry returns the normal plan draft.
Both attempts failing reject with one clear error stating the provider fetch failed after two attempts, carrying providerLogPath and the last provider response.
A first-attempt success performs exactly one invoke call with no retry delay.
Existing Plan Studio verification scripts still exercise their current success and gate-refusal paths unchanged.

acceptance_examples.given: the first provider invoke attempt fails by throwing or returning a non-zero code
acceptance_examples.when: runPlanProvider is called with confirm true and a fake invoke that succeeds on its second call
acceptance_examples.then: the helper waits 2 seconds, retries exactly once, and returns the normal plan draft with exactly two invoke calls recorded

acceptance_examples.when: runPlanProvider completes with a fake invoke that always fails
acceptance_examples.then: it rejects with a single clear error naming the provider fetch failed after two attempts, and the error carries providerLogPath plus the last provider response

acceptance_examples.given: the first provider invoke attempt succeeds
acceptance_examples.when: runPlanProvider runs normally with a fake invoke that succeeds immediately
acceptance_examples.then: exactly one invoke call is made, no retry delay is introduced, and the returned draft is unchanged from current behavior

acceptance_examples.given: the confirmation or usage gate refuses the call
acceptance_examples.when: runPlanProvider is called without confirm or with an exhausted budget
acceptance_examples.then: it rejects immediately with the existing refusal message and the invoke is never called, so no retry path runs

implementation_steps.step: Add a bounded retry helper (for example invokeProviderWithRetry) in runtime/lib/plan-studio.mjs that takes the invoke thunk and a delay (default 2000 ms), awaits the first attempt, on a thrown error or non-zero code waits the delay and retries once, and on a second failure throws the withLog-based error carrying providerLogPath and the last provider response.
implementation_steps.verify: Read the helper and confirm it performs at most two attempts, awaits the 2-second delay between them, and preserves the withLog error contract.

implementation_steps.step: Route the provider fetch in runPlanProvider through the retry helper, passing a delay parameter so tests can inject a short delay, while leaving the confirm and usage gates ahead of the first attempt and leaving regenerateProposal untouched.
implementation_steps.verify: Read runPlanProvider and confirm exactly one invoke site goes through the helper and no gate is re-evaluated between attempts.

implementation_steps.step: Extend verification/plan_studio_test.mjs with a fail-then-succeed fake invoke asserting two calls and a normal draft, an always-fail fake invoke asserting the single clear rejection with providerLogPath, and a succeed-first-time case asserting exactly one call, all using an injected short delay.
implementation_steps.verify: Read the new assertions and confirm they count invoke calls, cover both-failure and first-try-success paths, and inject the delay rather than sleeping 2 real seconds.

implementation_steps.step: Leave behavior of the success, missing-confirm, and exhausted-budget paths unchanged and do not touch regenerateProposal or any other fetch call site.
implementation_steps.verify: Read the diff scope and confirm only the retry helper, the runPlanProvider call site, and the Plan Studio test gained changes.
